\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization.formats.functions}
\begin{document}
\tikz \datavisualization [school book axes,
  x axis={min value=-2,max value=4,ticks={step=1},grid,length=6cm},
  y axis={include value={-1,1},ticks={step=.5},grid,length=3cm},
  visualize as smooth line=curve,curve={label in legend={text=$x^2/4$}},data/format=function]
data {var x : interval [-1:3] samples 9; func y = \value x*\value x/4;};
\end{document}
